title: Lightweight Cipher S-box Circuits (SKINNY-128, Ascon, Keccak-χ, PRESENT, GIFT, Spongent, Saturnin, KNOT, Clyde, Pyjamask)
description: Sixteen pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified Boolean-circuit hill-climb tracks minimizing total gates, multiplicative complexity (AND gates), and multiplicative depth (AND-depth for masked/MPC/FHE implementations) across ten NIST Lightweight Cryptography, FIPS 202, and ISO 29192-2 cipher S-boxes, pinned verbatim to `rweather/lightweight-crypto@fa4ec9a021` (MIT).

tasks.title: SKINNY-128 (8-bit S-box): minimize total gate count over {xor, xnor, and, not} (baseline 252)
tasks.description: Minimize total gate count over {xor, xnor, and, not} for the SKINNY-128 8-bit S-box (baseline 252, literature frontier: ~24). Submit a straight-line Boolean circuit in `LwcSbox/Skinny8TotalCircuit.lean` (`LwcSbox.skinny8TotalScore`, `LwcSbox.skinny8TotalGates`, `LwcSbox.skinny8TotalOutputs`). Frozen pure Lean 4.36.0 kernel proofs verify well-formedness, cost metric, and exact equivalence on all 2^8 inputs.
